title: Area formula on a bi-Lipschitz chart for Bochner integrals: ∫_A F dHⁿ = ∫_{Ω∩Φ⁻¹(A)} JΦ·F∘Φ dLⁿ
statement: Let E be a real Banach space, P, n ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P Lipschitz on Ω and κ-antilipschitz on Ω for some κ > 0, i.e. κ|w − w'| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w')| for w, w' ∈ Ω. Let A ⊆ Φ(Ω) be Hⁿ-null-measurable and F : ℝ^P → E Hⁿ⌞A-integrable, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^P and Lⁿ = volume on ℝⁿ. Put D := Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(A) and JΦ(w) := √det(⟨DΦ(w)e_i, DΦ(w)e_j⟩)_{i,j<n}, with DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w and e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Then D is Lⁿ-null-measurable, w ↦ JΦ(w)·F(Φ(w)) is Lⁿ-integrable on D, and ∫_A F dHⁿ = ∫_D JΦ(w)·F(Φ(w)) dLⁿ(w).
lean_statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (F : Eucl P → E), IsOpen Ω → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, κ * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → A ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn F A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A) (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun w => Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det • F (Φ w)) (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A) (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ ∫ x in A, F x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ w in Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A, Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det • F (Φ w) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n))
